comparison: Perfect claim overlap (C29, C30, C32, C55, C56) regarding Ezh2 ECKO experiments. Perfect claim overlap (C49, C67) on reversibility experiments. OpenEval finds evidence SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to culture artifact concerns, noting experiments were performed in cultured cells which limits confidence in relevance to in vivo BBB biology.

Perfect claim overlap (C63, C64) on Wnt7a developmental regulation. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, citing culture artifact concerns that undermine reliability of transcriptomic data from cultured cells.

High overlap (C25-C28, C31, C54) on Hdac2 ECKO phenotype. Both evaluations agree these findings are SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers explicitly praised the BBB leakage phenotype as 'striking' and noted these in vivo experiments avoid culture artifact concerns.

High overlap (C33-C38, C59) on differential Wnt pathway regulation. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, citing culture artifact concerns that apply to transcriptomic analysis and cultured cell experiments, though β-catenin translocation provides some support.

Strong overlap (C7, C39-C41) on epigenetic regulation of Wnt pathway. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to culture artifacts, qPCR methodology limitations, and lack of siRNA knockdown validation.

Strong overlap (C44, C45, C62) on β-catenin GOF experiments. Both evaluations agree these findings are SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers noted these in vivo genetic experiments avoid culture concerns and provide strong evidence for Wnt pathway regulation importance.

Good overlap (C8, C42-C43, C60-C61) on LF3-mediated Wnt inhibition driving BBB maturation. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to culture artifact concerns and qPCR methodology limitations.

Moderate overlap (C4, C12-C14) on transcriptional programs at different developmental stages. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, raising fundamental concerns that 'brain endothelial cells rapidly lose their organotypic features in culture' and the study may be examining culture artifacts rather than developmental biology.

Moderate overlap (C15-C18) on HDAC2 regulation of BBB genes. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, noting lack of siRNA knockdown validation and that findings are 'not particularly surprising' given HDAC2's broad epigenetic roles.

Partial overlap (C22-C24) on PRC2 role and histone modifications. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, criticizing qPCR methods as 'inferior to ChIPseq' and recommending whole genome sequencing approaches for quality assessment.
Limited overlap on C21 (PRC2 knockdown). OpenEval R3 finds PRC2 evidence SUPPORTED while peer R4 rates UNCERTAIN due to lack of siRNA validation and culture artifact concerns.
